title: Rhythm Melody ABC
hook: Time and pitch can travel together.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: polished 3D music-room storybook, one clear instrument or symbol per target; visual identity: Rhythm Melody ABC

creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: instrument/symbol fact tied to rhythm or pitch without false exclusivity
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Rhythm Melody ABC separate time from pitch: beat, duration, repeated pattern, contour, and sustained note are taught through instruments without claiming every percussion item has no pitch or every pitched item carries melody.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child can clap a pulse, hold a duration, then follow pitch movement; Quarter Note is a duration symbol inside this musical grammar.
